title: Wire migration default
contract: Decode old records {id} using default enabled=true; preserve explicit enabled=false in new records.
scope: IDs 0,1; enabled absent,true,false; no unknown fields in model.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: ID preserved; absence alone defaults true, explicit false stays false.

variants.description: Use truthiness instead of presence to select default.
